arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.
transliteration: Allahumma laa tayra illaa tayruk, wa laa khayra illaa khayruk, wa laa ilaaha ghayruk.
translation: O Allah, there is no bird except Your bird, and no good except Your good, and there is none worthy of worship but You.
reference: Ahmad 2/220, Ibn As-Sunni (no. 292), authenticated by Al-Albani
